episodes.instruction: Pick up the plastic fan and set it on the Tan mat facing the robot.
Grab the plastic fan with the right arm and position it on the Beige mat facing the robot.
Pick the fan with small round shape, place it on the Turquoise mat, face it toward the robot
Grab the fan with small round shape and set it on the Brown mat facing the robot.
Pick the beige circular blade fan and set it on the Silver mat facing the robot.
Pick the plastic fan, place it on the Green mat, face it toward the robot
Pick the off-white fan with beige accents, place it on the Orange mat, face it toward the robot
Use the right arm to grab the fan with small round shape and place it on the Black mat facing the robot.
